annotations.title: Derive roles from an employees board

description: Derive "who is this user and what is their role" from the data, instead of a grant per person: point at the employees board, its phone/email column, the column that says what each person does, and a map from that column's values to role keys. A signed-in user whose verified phone (or email) is in a row of that board gets that row's roles; a row that is not active gives none. Full replace. Example: { "board": "<Employees board id>", "phoneColumn": "<Phone column id>", "roleColumn": "<Position column id>", "roleMap": { "Agent": ["agent"], "Agents manager": ["manager"], "Owner": ["owner"] }, "activeColumn": "<Status column id>", "activeValues": ["Active"] }. Board and columns are ids (get_board_schema). A grant (grant_app_role) adds to what the board gives. Requires organization owner or admin.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

activeColumn.description: Column id that says whether the person is still active

activeValues.description: Values of activeColumn that count as active

board.description: Id of the board whose rows stand for people

emailColumn.description: Email column id on that board

phoneColumn.description: Phone column id on that board

roleColumn.description: Column id whose value says the person's position

roleMap.description: Value of roleColumn to role keys, e.g. { "Agent": ["agent"] }

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: set_policy_identity
